title: L-Proline catalysed synthesis and in silico studies of novel α-cyano bis(indolyl)chalcones as potential anti-cancer agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4593-4606
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06796G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Monika Malik, Nandini Roy, Asha Parveen Sakkarai Mohamed, Humphrey Lotana, Kavita Shah, Dalip Kumar
Various α-cyano bis(indolyl)chalcones synthesized in excellent yields (up to 95%) were found to display good cytotoxicity (IC50 = 0.9–5.8 μM) and caused apoptosis in C4-2 cells.
